paper_title: Search for Dark Matter Axions with Tunable TM_020 mode
notes: Cavity haloscope search using tunable TM020 mode over mass range 21.38-21.79 ueV (5.17-5.27 GHz). Excludes g_agamma > 12.0 x g_KSVZ at 90% CL. KSVZ coupling at this mass is approximately 1e-13 GeV^-1, so the limit is roughly 12x that (~1.2e-12 GeV^-1). Exact numerical coupling values not tabulated; abstract states ~10^-13 GeV^-1.
